# ==============================================================================
# Workflow Name: Banking App Multi-Service CI/CD Pipeline
# Description: Uses official Docker GitHub Actions to authenticate, build,
#              push container images to Docker Hub, and launch services on
#              a dedicated Docker network with persistent volumes.
# ==============================================================================

name: Build, Push, and Run Banking Services

# Trigger the workflow on push or pull requests to main/master branches
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  build-push-deploy:
    name: Build, Push and Run Services
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 1: Check out repository source code
      # Action: actions/checkout@v4
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Checkout Source Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 2: Set up Docker Buildx (Official Docker Builder Toolkit)
      # Action: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 3: Log in to Docker Hub using official credentials action
      # Action: docker/login-action@v3
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Log in to Docker Hub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_PASSWORD }}

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 4: Build & Push Frontend Image
      # Image Tag: hari930531/Bank_Frontend:latest
      # Action: docker/build-push-action@v5
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build and Push Bank_Frontend
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./frontend
          file: ./frontend/Dockerfile
          push: true
          load: true
          tags: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/Bank_Frontend:latest

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 5: Build & Push Account Service Image
      # Image Tag: hari930531/account-service:latest
      # Action: docker/build-push-action@v5
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build and Push account-service
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./account-service
          file: ./account-service/Dockerfile
          push: true
          load: true
          tags: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/account-service:latest

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 6: Build & Push Transfer Service Image
      # Image Tag: hari930531/transfer-service:latest
      # Action: docker/build-push-action@v5
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build and Push transfer-service
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./transfer-service
          file: ./transfer-service/Dockerfile
          push: true
          load: true
          tags: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/transfer-service:latest

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 7: Build & Push Auth Service Image
      # Image Tag: hari930531/auth-service:latest
      # Action: docker/build-push-action@v5
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Build and Push auth-service
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v5
        with:
          context: ./auth-service
          file: ./auth-service/Dockerfile
          push: true
          load: true
          tags: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/auth-service:latest

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 8: Initialize Network & Persistent Volume
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Create Custom Network and Storage Volume
        run: |
          echo "Creating custom bridge network: bank-network"
          docker network create bank-network

          echo "Creating MySQL database volume: mysql_data"
          docker volume create mysql_data

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 9: Launch Containers on Shared Network
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Start All Containers
        run: |
          echo "1. Starting MySQL database container..."
          docker run -d \
            --name bank-mysql \
            --network bank-network \
            -v mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql \
            -v ${{ github.workspace }}/init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql \
            -e MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD=Admin@123 \
            -e MYSQL_DATABASE=bankdb \
            -p 3306:3306 \
            mysql:8.0

          echo "Waiting 15 seconds for MySQL initialization..."
          sleep 15

          echo "2. Starting Account Service container..."
          docker run -d \
            --name account-service_container \
            --network bank-network \
            -e DB_HOST=bank-mysql \
            -p 5001:5001 \
            ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/account-service:latest

          echo "3. Starting Transfer Service container..."
          docker run -d \
            --name transfer-service_container \
            --network bank-network \
            -p 5002:5002 \
            ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/transfer-service:latest

          echo "4. Starting Auth Service container..."
          docker run -d \
            --name auth-service_container \
            --network bank-network \
            -e DB_HOST=bank-mysql \
            -p 5003:5003 \
            ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/auth-service:latest

          echo "5. Starting Frontend container..."
          docker run -d \
            --name Bank_Frontend_container \
            --network bank-network \
            -p 5500:80 \
            ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}/Bank_Frontend:latest

      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Step 10: Inspect Running Containers & Network
      # ------------------------------------------------------------------------
      - name: Inspect Runtime Status
        run: |
          echo "Listing running containers:"
          docker ps -a

          echo "Listing active networks:"
          docker network inspect bank-network
